outline: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解離散時間訊號處理之知識，包含Z-轉換、連續訊號取樣、線性非時變系統、濾波器設計、離散傅立葉轉換以及快速傅立葉轉換等。
schedule:
(subject to change based on class progress)
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Discrete-Time Signals and Systems
Week 3-4: Fourier Series and Fourier Transform
Week 5: Midterm I
Week 6-7: Discrete-Time Fourier Transform (DTFT)
Week 8-9: Sampling of Continuous-Time Signals
Week 10: Z-Transform and Digital Filter Design
Week 11-12: Discrete Fourier transform (DFT) and Fast Fourier transform (FFT)
Week 13: Midterm II
Week 14-16: Final Project

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
線上數位教材學習(Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
flexible_learning.content: 自行上網選擇一個與課程內容相關之線上課程，觀看完之後根據心得以及反思撰寫一份報告；例如可思考線上課程之授課方式與內容與本課程之間的差異，而此差異是否帶來新的想法與啟發。

assessment:
Quizzes (Weekly): 25%
Midterm I: 20%
Midterm II: 20%
Final project: 35%
所有考試基本上為open book
